submitted.rationale: Of the 5 EQE measurements, index 3 (Sb 0.19) had the highest EQE at 0.107%. The other results were 0.067% at Sb 0.12, 0.069% at 0.31, 0.031% at 0.52 and 0.022% at 0.69. So EQE peaks somewhere around Sb 0.15–0.25. XRD at Sb 0.19 shows only a rutile-type phase. At Sb 0.12, XRD shows an extra low-Q peak at 0.80 Å⁻¹, which may be a second phase, and EQE drops there.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.067% EQE, lower than index 3; XRD shows an extra peak at Q=0.80, possibly a second phase
Measured 0.031% EQE, near the FeSbO4 composition
Measured 0.022% EQE; the Sb-rich end performs poorly
